description: Smell the cloves on Zanzibar's spice farms with Zuhura.

choices.label: Asante sana! (Thank you very much!)
choices.reply: Zuhura smiles. "Asante sana! The spices are waiting."

choices.label: Shikamoo! (Respectful greeting!)
choices.reply: Zuhura bows slightly. "Marahaba! You know our ways."

scene1.culture: Zanzibar is called the Spice Island; cloves built its fortune.
scene1.translation: "Welcome to Zanzibar!" Zuhura greets you at the spice farm gate.

choices.label: Nzuri! (Nice!)
choices.reply: You breathe in deeply; the garden smells like heaven.

choices.label: Nataka hii! (I want this!)
choices.reply: Zuhura laughs and wraps some spices for you.

scene2.culture: Clove, cinnamon and cardamom grow side by side on Zanzibar's farms.
scene2.translation: "This is clove." Zuhura crushes a bud; the scent fills the air.

scene3.culture: Stone Town's carved wooden doors tell stories of the traders who passed through.
scene3.translation: "Goodbye, we shall meet again!" The dhow sails past Stone Town.

title: Zanzibar Spice Adventure
